    • fullIntAbstraction

      default MutableDeterministicAbstractions.FullIntAbstraction<T,SP,TP> fullIntAbstraction(Alphabet<I> alphabet)
      Description copied from interface: SimpleDeterministicAutomaton
      Retrieves a SimpleDeterministicAbstractions.FullIntAbstraction of this automaton, using the mapping induced by the given alphabet as the abstraction for the input symbols.

      This method is provided for convenience. It is equivalent to calling fullIntAbstraction(alphabet.size(), alphabet).
